findings.claim: The assessment authorizes editing the full skill-pack repository even though the packet constraints make it reference-only and forbid writes.
findings.evidence: Assessment says: "Identical new runtime in full and mini; edits only inside the two authorized repositories" and conflict 8 says: "this user explicitly authorizes both repositories. Record a scoped phase exception". The constraints say: "`/Users/gqadonis/Projects/prometheus/prometheus-skill-pack` | another repository | Reference only ... **Never written**, including its worktrees" and the blocking constraint `reference-repo-untouched` says: "Nothing under prometheus-skill-pack ... is created, modified or deleted".
findings.suggested_fix: Revise the assessment to treat prometheus-skill-pack as read-only unless the packet includes an explicit constraint override; frame full-pack work as reference analysis or require an operator/constraint change before any plan edits it.

findings.claim: The assessment misses the goal requirement to push, including its conflict with the project constraints.
findings.evidence: Goals include: "Update distributions and Docusaurus, validate locally, commit and push". The assessment never analyzes a push gap or push constraint; it only says "No final validation, publication or release is claimed." The constraints state workflow commits are local only: "nothing here pushes, files or publishes (A-16)."
findings.suggested_fix: Add a gap/conflict section for the push requirement: identify whether push is prohibited by A-16 for this phase, requires explicit human action, or needs a scoped authorization before Plan can include it.
